description: Who the fund is, legally: its name, its form, its size.

questions.text: What is the fund's full name, and which share classes are offered to investors?
questions.context_prompt: Start with the legal documents (prospectus, offering memorandum, articles). Quote the name exactly as written there, and list each share class with its currency.

questions.text: Where is the fund domiciled, and under which legal form and regulatory regime does it operate?
questions.context_prompt: Prospectus or offering memorandum. Give the country, the legal form and the regulatory framework, each with the document it comes from.

questions.text: When did the fund start investing, and how large is it today?
questions.context_prompt: Latest factsheet or annual report. Give the launch date, then the most recent assets under management with their date and currency.

description: The management company and the people who take the investment decisions.

questions.text: Which company manages the fund, and who owns it?
questions.context_prompt: Company presentation, the manager's website, the regulator's public register. Name the shareholders and their stakes when disclosed; say plainly when they are not.

questions.text: Who makes the investment decisions, and how long have these people worked together?
questions.context_prompt: Team biographies in the presentation or the factsheet. For each decision-maker: role, years at the firm, years of experience.

questions.text: Has anyone joined or left the investment team over the past three years?
questions.context_prompt: Compare the team lists of documents from different years (presentations, annual reports, press releases). Answer "no change found" only if the documents cover the whole period.

description: What the fund tries to achieve, and how it builds its portfolio.

questions.text: What is the fund's investment objective, and against which benchmark is it measured, if any?
questions.context_prompt: Investment objective section of the prospectus, and the factsheet. Quote the objective; name the benchmark, or state that the fund has none.

questions.text: How are investments selected, from the starting universe to the final portfolio?
questions.context_prompt: Presentation, description of the investment process, due diligence questionnaire. Describe the steps in order, with the criteria applied at each one.

questions.text: Which limits apply to the portfolio (concentration, leverage, liquidity, currency exposure)?
questions.context_prompt: Investment restrictions and risk sections of the prospectus. List each limit with its figure.

description: Who watches the risks, with which measures, and what happens when a limit is crossed.

questions.text: Who monitors the fund's risks, and is that function independent from portfolio management?
questions.context_prompt: Risk management policy, organisation chart, due diligence questionnaire. Say who the risk team reports to.

questions.text: Which risk measures are followed, and what happens when a limit is breached?
questions.context_prompt: Risk management policy, risk reports. List the measures and their limits, then the escalation procedure step by step.

questions.text: Have any limit breaches or significant errors occurred over the past three years?
questions.context_prompt: Annual reports, auditor's letters, compliance reports. Give dates, causes and corrective actions; if no document covers the question, say so rather than conclude there were none.

description: The firms around the fund, its valuation and its dealing terms.

questions.text: Who are the fund's depositary, administrator and auditor?
questions.context_prompt: Directory or service providers page of the prospectus, annual report. Give each firm's full name and country.

questions.text: How often is the portfolio valued, by whom, and how are hard-to-value assets priced?
questions.context_prompt: Valuation policy, prospectus. Give the frequency, the party responsible and the method for illiquid assets.

questions.text: On which terms can investors subscribe and redeem (frequency, notice period, gates, lock-up)?
questions.context_prompt: Dealing section of the prospectus, factsheet. Give each term with its figure, and say which share classes it applies to when they differ.

description: What investing costs, and what the fund commits to on sustainability.

questions.text: Which fees are charged to investors (management, performance, entry, exit), and how is the performance fee calculated?
questions.context_prompt: Fees section of the prospectus, key information document. Give each fee per share class; for the performance fee, its rate, its hurdle and its high-water mark.

questions.text: Which other costs are paid by the fund itself (transactions, research, service providers), and what are its total ongoing charges?
questions.context_prompt: Statement of expenses in the annual report, key information document. Give the latest ongoing charges figure with its date, then the main cost items.

questions.text: Does the fund make sustainability commitments, and how are they monitored?
questions.context_prompt: Sustainability disclosures, responsible investment policy, prospectus annexes. State a classification only if a document states it, and quote the commitments with their source.
